exam.title: بنك الأسئلة الشامل للغة الإنجليزية - الجامعة الافتراضية (الجزء السادس)
exam.description: الأسئلة من 501 إلى 600 - مع شرح مفصل لكل إجابة

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: I like a bit of cheese after my main course.
The reason he's so bogged down at work is that he's had a heavy cold for the last fortnight.
His death came as a terrible shock to his colleagues.
They've always dreamed of living in a countryside.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'a countryside' غير صحيحة. نقول 'the countryside' أو 'in the country'. 'countryside' هو اسم غير معدود عادةً ولا نستخدم معه 'a'. الجملة الصحيحة: 'They've always dreamed of living in the countryside.'

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: Rents in Tokyo are high compared to those in other cities.
The cost of living is as high as in Tokyo than in Bucharest.
The population of Tokyo proper is nearly the same as that of New York City.
Tokyo's problems are similar to those of other large cities.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'as high as in Tokyo than' خطأ. الصحيح: 'higher in Tokyo than' أو 'as high as in Bucharest'. الجملة تخلط بين صيغة المقارنة 'than' وصيغة المساواة 'as...as'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Cleveland is now one of the most cleanest cities in North America.
In Buenos Aires, foreign bankers are as common than coffee house poets.
The London Underground is worst than the Tokyo Underground system.
Their prices are very high in compassion to ours.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'in compassion to' تعني 'بالمقارنة مع'، وهي قريبة من 'in comparison to'. الخيارات الأخرى بها أخطاء: 'most cleanest' مزدوجة، 'as common than' خطأ، و'worst than' يجب أن تكون 'worse than'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: All questionnaires received by January 22 will being entered in a luxury vacation sweepstakes.
The winner will to enjoy a free trip to Hong Kong.
Winners will be flying First Class to Honolulu.
The CEO's plane will have landing by 4:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'will be flying' = future continuous صحيح. الخيارات الأخرى: 'will being' خطأ، 'will to enjoy' خطأ، و'will have landing' خطأ (الصحيح 'will have landed').

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: The hotel is in a lovely location overlooking the lake.
A couple of victories would improve a general morale.
A new rail network is being installed this month.
The winner will enjoy a week-long stay in an accommodation of their choice in Las Vegas.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'a general morale' خطأ. 'morale' هو اسم غير معدود (معنويات)، لذا نقول 'general morale' بدون 'a'. الجملة الصحيحة: 'A couple of victories would improve general morale.'

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: We won't be able to start construction unif you train our personnel.
If this deal went well, we will make another agreement in the fall.
We can reach agreement on a joint venture provides that our firm has a representative on your board.
Unless you correct the design flaw, we will face a recall down the line.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Unless you correct... we will face' = جملة شرطية صحيحة. 'Unless' تعني 'إذا لم'. الخيارات الأخرى: 'unif' خطأ إملائي، 'went' مع 'will' غير صحيحة، و'provides' يجب أن تكون 'provided'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT question.
options: Do you have a small or a large family?
Does all of the people in your family live here?
Do you often call or email your friends?
Do your relatives speak English fluently?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Does all of the people' خطأ. 'people' جمع، لذا نستخدم 'Do all of the people'. الصحيح: 'Do all of the people in your family live here?'

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: His wife said, 'You need to see a doctor.'
The doctors wasn't said his problem was funny.
We don't think his problem was serious.
The doctors thanked Sam had sleep apnea.
questions.explanation: 🔍 جملة منقولة بشكل صحيح. الخيارات الأخرى: 'wasn't said' خطأ، 'was' يجب أن تكون 'is'، و'thanked Sam had' يجب أن تكون 'thanked Sam for having'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: Joan saw a commercial for a special travel store on TV.
She didn't see a commercial for pet food last time.
Sue has made a list of all of the reasons to enjoy flying.
She didn't make a list of reasons to avoid flying.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'has made' مع 'all of the reasons' فيها خطأ في الصياغة. الأصح استخدام الماضي البسيط 'made' لأن الفعل حدث وانتهى. 'Sue made a list of all the reasons...'

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: Charlie used to sits in a high chair.
Charlie used to sleep in a crib.
Charlie used to play with toys all day.
Charlie used to sleep with a teddy bear.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'used to sits' خطأ. بعد 'used to' نستخدم المصدر (V1). الصحيح: 'Charlie used to sit in a high chair.'

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT question.
options: How much water do you drink when you exercise?
How much times a week do you eat in fast food restaurants?
How many pieces of cake do you have for dessert?
How much bread do you have with dinner?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'How much times' خطأ. 'times' معدودة، لذا نستخدم 'How many times'. الصحيح: 'How many times a week do you eat in fast food restaurants?'

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Reiko is 19 years old and likes music a lot.
Reiko is 19 years old, she likes music a lot.
Reiko is 19 years old, and likes music a lot.
And Reiko is 19 years old, she like music a lot.
questions.explanation: 🔍 جملة صحيحة برابط 'and' بين جملتين. الخيار الثاني به فاصلة (comma splice)، والثالث 'likes' بدون فاعل، والرابع 'she like' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Salma is married, and a student.
Salma is married and a student.
Salma is married, and Salma is a student.
Salma is married and Salma a student.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Salma is married and a student' = جملة صحيحة بدون فاصلة غير ضرورية. الخيار الثالث صحيح ولكن به تكرار غير ضروري لـ 'Salma'.

questions.question: Ms. Lee is my English teacher. Choose the CORRECT question.
options: Who is your English teacher?
How is your English teacher?
Whom does your English teacher?
Whom your English teacher is?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Who is your English teacher?' = سؤال عن الفاعل. 'How' يسأل عن الحال، و'Whom' يجب أن يتبعه فعل مع مفعول به.

questions.question: Cold water is always in the refrigerator. Choose the CORRECT question.
options: Where is the cold water?
Where does the cold water?
Where has cold watered?
What is cold water in?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Where is the cold water?' = سؤال عن المكان. 'Where does' يحتاج إلى فعل، و'has watered' تعني 'سقى'، و'What is cold water in' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT order.
options: After my father died my mother went to work.
After my father died, my mother went to work.
My mother went to work after my father died.
After, my mother went to work, my father died.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الفاصلة بعد جملة الزمان ضرورية. 'After my father died, my mother went to work.' الخيار الثالث صحيح أيضاً ولكن بدون فاصلة. الخيار الرابع يغير المعنى.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: It's making a birthday cake is to fun.
To making a birthday cake is fun.
Making a birthday cake is fun.
You are fun to make a birthday cake.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Making a birthday cake is fun.' = Gerund كفاعل. الخيارات الأخرى: 'It's making...is to fun' خطأ، 'To making' خطأ، و'You are fun' تغير المعنى.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: Ali may open a savings account.
Ali might sell his Persian rug.
Perhaps Michael maybe take Finance 101.
Michael might look for a job.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Perhaps Michael maybe take' خطأ. 'Perhaps' و'maybe' كلاهما ظرفان ولا نستخدمهما معاً. الصحيح: 'Perhaps Michael might take Finance 101.'

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Ali might has the opportunity to buy a used bike.
Michael might to have a chance to vacation in Mexico.
Ali may go along on the trip.
Michael may be buy a new car.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Ali may go along on the trip.' = جملة صحيحة. 'may' + V1. الخيارات الأخرى: 'might has' خطأ، 'might to have' خطأ، و'may be buy' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: The music was so loud then I couldn't hear anything.
The music was so loud that I couldn't hear anything.
The music was so loudly that I couldn't hear anything.
The music was very loud that I couldn't hear anything.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'so + adjective + that' = الصيغة الصحيحة. 'so loud that I couldn't hear' = عالٍ لدرجة أنني لم أستطع السماع. 'then' خطأ، و'loudly' حال وليس صفة.

questions.question: Astronomers have discovered new stars. Choose the CORRECT passive sentence.
options: New stars were discovered by astronomers.
New stars have been discovered by astronomers.
New stars are discovered by astronomers.
New stars will be discovered by astronomers.
questions.explanation: 🔍 المضارع التام في المجهول: have/has + been + V3. 'have been discovered' = تم اكتشافها. 'were' للماضي البسيط، و'are' للحاضر، و'will' للمستقبل.

questions.question: Several countries are developing joint research projects. Choose the CORRECT passive sentence.
options: Joint research projects are developed.
Joint research projects were developed.
Joint research projects are being developed.
Joint research projects have been developed.
questions.explanation: 🔍 المضارع المستمر في المجهول: am/is/are + being + V3. 'are being developed' = يتم تطويرها حالياً. 'are developed' للحقائق العامة.

questions.question: Then, humans must find other places to live. Choose the CORRECT passive sentence.
options: Then, other places to live should be finding.
Then, other places to live should be found.
questions.explanation: 🔍 مع أفعال المودال في المجهول: modal + be + V3. 'should be found' = يجب أن يتم إيجادها. 'should be finding' خطأ لأن 'finding' ليس V3.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: There are many medical myths whose educated people believe them.
There are many medical myths whom educated people believe.
There are many medical myths in which educated people believe.
There are many medical myths that educated people believe.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'whose educated people believe them' خطأ. 'whose' تستخدم للملكية. الصحيح: 'that educated people believe' أو 'in which educated people believe'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: A friend encouraged me to buying a new camera.
I except to learn a great deal about early films.
I was able to find several good film classes last time.
I decided to take several classes last semester.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'encouraged me to buying' خطأ. بعد 'encouraged me to' نستخدم المصدر (V1). الصحيح: 'A friend encouraged me to buy a new camera.'

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: When we communicate, each of we speak two distinct languages.
We express ourselves with our bodies as well as with our words.
People's movements often communicate more than them words.
Each culture has it's own body language.
questions.explanation: 🔍 جملة صحيحة. الخيارات الأخرى: 'each of we' يجب أن تكون 'each of us'، 'them words' يجب أن تكون 'their words'، و'it's' يجب أن تكون 'its' (ملكية).

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT question.
options: Have you studied until late last night?
Study until late last night?
Did you studied until late last night?
Did you study until late last night?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Did you study' = past simple سؤال صحيح. 'Have you studied' للمضارع التام، و'last night' مع الماضي البسيط. 'Did you studied' خطأ لأن بعد 'did' نستخدم المصدر.

questions.question: I usually study there once or twice a week. Choose the CORRECT question.
options: How often do you study at the library?
When do you study here?
What do you study here?
How long do you study here?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'How often' = السؤال عن التكرار. الجواب 'once or twice a week' يدل على التكرار. 'When' يسأل عن الوقت، و'What' عن الشيء، و'How long' عن المدة.

questions.question: A: Oh, you have an apartment. ______? B: About five blocks from here.
options: How long do you live from the library?
How far do you live from the library?
Who lives about five blocks from here?
Where are you living?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'How far' = السؤال عن المسافة. الجواب 'About five blocks from here' يدل على المسافة. 'How long' يسأل عن المدة، و'Who' عن الشخص.

questions.question: A: ______ B: Oh, it's my watch. Sorry!
options: How is beeping?
What beeping?
Which is watch beeping?
Whose watch is beeping?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Whose watch is beeping?' = سؤال عن الملكية. الجواب 'it's my watch' يحدد المالك. 'What beeping' غير صحيحة، و'Which' يسأل عن الاختيار.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: Could you hold my hat, darling?
Would you mind moving a little?
Would you mind not giving me orders?
Would you going to another section?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Would you going' خطأ. الصحيح: 'Would you go' أو 'Would you mind going'. 'Would you going' يخلط بين صيغتين مختلفتين.

questions.question: A: ______ B: Of course. What name shall I put it under?
options: May you to give me a six o'clock reservation?
Can you give me a six o'clock reservation?
Would you mind give me a six o'clock reservation?
Should you give me a six o'clock reservation?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Can you give me...' = طلب مهذب. 'May you to' خطأ، و'Would you mind' تتبعها V-ing، و'Should' تعني 'ينبغي'.

questions.question: A: ______ B: No, I wouldn't. I forgot to take it off. Sorry.
options: Would you minding remove your hat?
Can you removing your hat?
Would you mind removing your hat?
Would you removing your hat?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Would you mind + V-ing' = طلب مهذب. 'Would you mind removing your hat?' = هل تمانع في خلع قبعتك؟ 'minding' خطأ، و'Can you removing' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: I'd like to compete in the Olympics.
I'd really rather to hire my own private chef.
I don't rather move to Paris.
I'd prefer not run a marathon.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'I'd like to compete' = جملة صحيحة. 'would rather' تتبعها V1 بدون 'to'، و'prefer' تتبعها 'to + V1' أو 'V-ing'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT question.
options: Would you to like a Ph.D.?
Wouldn't you rather a Ph.D.?
Would you to rather a Ph.D.?
Wouldn't you like a Ph.D.?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Wouldn't you like a Ph.D.?' = سؤال مهذب. 'Would you to like' خطأ، و'Rather' تحتاج إلى V1 بعدها.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT question.
options: Should Nancy take Vitamin C every morning?
Should Carlos have spent several hours reading his health insurance policy?
Shouldn't Ted check his blood pressure every morning?
Ought Ali have to studied for his anatomy exam last night?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Ought Ali have to studied' خطأ. الصحيح: 'Ought Ali to have studied' أو 'Should Ali have studied'. 'Ought' تتبعها 'to + V1'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT PASSIVE sentence.
options: Mr. Jones will be given the results of the test to the students within the next week.
Mr. Jones will give the results of the test to the students within the next week.
The results of the test will be given to the students within the next week.
The students will be given the results of the test by Mr. Jones within the next week.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Mr. Jones will be given the results... to the students' خطأ في الصياغة. الصحيح: 'The results will be given to the students' أو 'The students will be given the results'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT PASSIVE sentence.
options: Mr. Sanchez was shown some computer software by the salesman.
Some computer software was shown to Mr. Sanchez by the sales person.
The salesman showed Mr. Sanchez some computer software.
The salesman was showed Mr. Sanchez some computer software.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'was showed' خطأ. التصريف الثالث لـ 'show' هو 'shown'. الصحيح: 'The salesman showed Mr. Sanchez...' (معلوم) أو 'Mr. Sanchez was shown...' (مجهول).

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT PASSIVE sentence.
options: Every year, a rich businesswoman gives our town $100,000 to spend on the schools.
Every year, $100,000 is given by a rich businesswoman to be spent on the schools.
Every year, our town is given $100,000 to be spent on the schools by a businesswoman.
Every year, a rich business is given our town $100,000 to spend on the schools.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'a rich business is given our town' خطأ في الصياغة. الصحيح: 'a rich businesswoman gives our town $100,000' أو 'our town is given $100,000 by a rich businesswoman'.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that CAN be changed to Passive.
options: The U.S. patent office received Bell's application two hours before Gray's.
One was a schoolteacher named Alexander Graham Bell.
The other was a professional inventor named Elisha Gray.
Gray finished first.
questions.explanation: 🔍 فقط الجمل التي تحتوي على مفعول به يمكن تحويلها للمبني للمجهول. 'received' لها مفعول به (Bell's application). الجمل الأخرى لا تحتوي على مفعول به.

questions.question: Robots might replace human workers in dangerous areas. Choose the CORRECT passive sentence.
options: Human workers might be replaced by robots.
Human workers might be replaced by robots.
Human workers might be replacing by robots.
Human workers might being replaced by robots.
questions.explanation: 🔍 مع 'might' في المجهول: might + be + V3. 'might be replaced' = قد يتم استبدالهم. 'replacing' و'being' غير صحيحتين.

questions.question: In the future, people will use artificial intelligence. Choose the CORRECT passive sentence.
options: Artificial intelligence would be used to create robots.
Artificial intelligence will be using to create robots.
Artificial intelligence will be used to create robots.
Artificial intelligence will be to used to create robots.
questions.explanation: 🔍 مع 'will' في المجهول: will + be + V3. 'will be used' = سيتم استخدامها. 'would' للماضي، و'using' و'to used' غير صحيحتين.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT answer. (Personnel + Policy)
options: A policy's of personnel
A personnel policy
A policy of personnel
A personnel's policy
questions.explanation: 🔍 'A policy of personnel' = سياسة الموظفين. هذه هي الصيغة الصحيحة باستخدام 'of' للملكية. 'personnel policy' تستخدم أيضاً ولكنها أقل شيوعاً.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT answer. (Salary + Increase)
options: A salary increase
An increase of salary
A salaries increase
A salary's increase's
questions.explanation: 🔍 'A salary increase' = زيادة في الراتب. هذه هي الصيغة الأكثر شيوعاً. 'An increase of salary' صحيحة أيضاً ولكن 'salary increase' أكثر استخداماً.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT answer. (Breach + Contract)
options: A contract breach
A contract's breach
A breach's contact
A breach of contract
questions.explanation: 🔍 'A breach of contract' = خرق العقد. هذه هي الصيغة الصحيحة باستخدام 'of'. 'contract breach' تستخدم أيضاً ولكن 'breach of contract' أكثر شيوعاً في السياقات القانونية.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT answer. (Unemployment + Figures)
options: Unemployment figures
figures of unemployment
Unemployment's figures
figures' unemployment
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Unemployment figures' = أرقام البطالة. هذه هي الصيغة الأكثر شيوعاً (اسم + اسم). 'figures of unemployment' صحيحة أيضاً ولكنها أقل شيوعاً.

questions.question: What are your strengths? Choose the CORRECT indirect question.
options: Could you tell me what your strengths are?
Could you tell me what are your strengths?
Could you tell me if your strengths are?
Could you tell me what do your strengths are?
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر نضع الفاعل قبل الفعل. 'what your strengths are' = ما هي نقاط قوتك. 'what are' خطأ في غير المباشر، و'if' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: What would your colleagues say about you? Choose the CORRECT indirect question.
options: I would like to know what do your colleagues say about you?
I'd like to know what would your colleagues say about you.
I would like to know would your colleagues say about you?
I'd like to know what your colleagues would say about you.
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر: فاعل + فعل. 'what your colleagues would say about you' = ماذا سيقول زملاؤك عنك. 'would' بعد الفاعل وليس قبله.

questions.question: How have you changed in the last five years? Choose the CORRECT indirect question.
options: Could you tell me if have you changed in the last five years?
Could you tell me how you have changed in the last five years?
Could you tell me have you changed in the last five years?
Could you tell me how have you changed in the last five years?
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر: فاعل + فعل. 'how you have changed' = كيف تغيرت. 'have you' خطأ في غير المباشر، و'if' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Where did you work last year? Choose the CORRECT indirect question.
options: Can I know where you worked last year?
Can I know where did you work last year?
Can I know where did you worked last year?
Can I know if you work last year?
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر: فاعل + فعل. 'where you worked last year' = أين عملت السنة الماضية. 'did you' خطأ، و'if you work' تغير المعنى.

questions.question: He has a dependency on alcohol. What does 'dependency' mean?
options: a place of misfortune
fulfilled my sentence in prison
attacking or beating up someone
condition of needing and being controlled by
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Dependency' = حالة من الاعتماد والإدمان. 'dependency on alcohol' = إدمان الكحول. الخيارات الأخرى: مكان تعيس، قضاء فترة في السجن، اعتداء جسدي.

questions.question: It's in the city's hard-luck Downtown Eastside. What does 'hard-luck' mean?
options: a place of misfortune
attacking or beating up someone
fulfilled my sentence in prison
condition of needing and being controlled by
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Hard-luck' = مكان تعيس يعيش فيه أشخاص في ظروف صعبة. 'hard-luck area' = منطقة تعيسة. الخيارات الأخرى لا تناسب المعنى.

questions.question: Her mind is addled by crack cocaine. What does 'addled' mean?
options: without drugs or alcohol
theft; stealing things
confused; mixed up mentally
relapse; go back to old ways
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Addled' = مشوش عقلياً. 'Her mind is addled' = عقلها مشوش. الخيارات الأخرى: بدون مخدرات، سرقة، انتكاسة.

questions.question: They have been ground down by homelessness. What does 'ground down' mean?
options: fixing the wrong that was done
before, when there was money
scaring people into paying money
living on the streets
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Ground down' = أنهكوا بسبب ظروف صعبة. 'ground down by homelessness' = أنهكهم التشرد. الخيارات الأخرى: إصلاح الخطأ، قبل وجود المال، إخافة الناس.

questions.question: He was in jail for robberies. What does 'robberies' mean?
options: without drugs or alcohol
confused; mixed up mentally
theft; stealing things
relapse; go back to old ways
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Robberies' = سرقات. 'robbery' هي جريمة السرقة. الخيارات الأخرى: بدون مخدرات، مشوش عقلياً، انتكاسة.

questions.question: He was in jail for extortion. What does 'extortion' mean?
options: fixing the wrong that was done
scaring people into paying money
before, when there was money
living on the streets
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Extortion' = ابتزاز، إخافة الناس ليدفعوا المال. 'extortion' هي جريمة الابتزاز. الخيارات الأخرى لا تناسب المعنى.

questions.question: He was in jail for assault. What does 'assault' mean?
options: a place of misfortune
attacking or beating up someone
fulfilled my sentence in prison
condition of needing and being controlled by
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Assault' = اعتداء جسدي. 'assault' هي جريمة الاعتداء بالضرب. الخيارات الأخرى: مكان تعيس، قضاء فترة في السجن، إدمان.

questions.question: He was in jail for trafficking. What does 'trafficking' mean?
options: tricks to cheat people
buying and selling drugs
an addictive drug
theft; stealing things
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Trafficking' = الاتجار (بالمخدرات). 'drug trafficking' = الاتجار بالمخدرات. الخيارات الأخرى: خداع، مادة مخدرة، سرقة.

questions.question: He was in jail for small-time cons. What does 'cons' mean?
options: tricks to cheat people
an addictive drug
buying and selling drugs
theft; stealing things
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Cons' = خداع. 'con' هي اختصار لـ 'confidence trick' أي خدعة. 'small-time cons' = خدع صغيرة. الخيارات الأخرى لا تناسب.

questions.question: Back when things were flush, they bought many things. What does 'flush' mean?
options: fixing the wrong that was done
scaring people into paying money
before, when there was money
living on the streets
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Flush' = وفرة في المال. 'when things were flush' = عندما كانت الأمور مزدهرة (مالياً). الخيارات الأخرى: إصلاح الخطأ، إخافة الناس، التشرد.

questions.question: It is very hard to leave heroin alone. What does 'heroin' mean?
options: tricks to cheat people
an addictive drug
buying and selling drugs
theft; stealing things
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Heroin' = مادة مخدرة (الهيروين). هي مادة تسبب الإدمان. الخيارات الأخرى: خداع، الاتجار، سرقة.

questions.question: He's been clean for four months. What does 'clean' mean?
options: without drugs or alcohol
confused; mixed up mentally
theft; stealing things
relapse; go back to old ways
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Clean' = بعيد عن الإدمان. 'clean for four months' = نظيف (من المخدرات) لأربعة أشهر. الخيارات الأخرى: مشوش، سرقة، انتكاسة.

questions.question: I did my time. What does 'did my time' mean?
options: a place of misfortune
attacking or beating up someone
fulfilled my sentence in prison
condition of needing and being controlled by
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Did my time' = قضيت فترة حكمي في السجن. 'time' هنا تعني مدة السجن. الخيارات الأخرى: مكان تعيس، اعتداء، إدمان.

questions.question: That's not making amends. What does 'making amends' mean?
options: fixing the wrong that was done
scaring people into paying money
before, when there was money
living on the streets
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Making amends' = إصلاح الخطأ الذي تم. 'make amends' = تعويض أو تصحيح خطأ. الخيارات الأخرى: إخافة الناس، وفرة مالية، التشرد.

questions.question: He knows some members will backslide. What does 'backslide' mean?
options: without drugs or alcohol
confused; mixed up mentally
theft; stealing things
relapse; go back to old ways
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Backslide' = انتكاسة، العودة للعادات القديمة. 'backslide' تعني الرجوع إلى السلوك السيء بعد التحسن. الخيارات الأخرى لا تناسب.

questions.question: Some of the men at the meeting are clean-cut. What does 'clean-cut' mean?
options: rough looking and menacing
shaven and well groomed
old and unhealthy
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Clean-cut' = محلوق الذقن وحسن الهندام. يوصف الشخص الذي يبدو مرتباً وأنيقاً. الخيارات الأخرى: خشن المظهر، قديم وغير صحي.

questions.question: Some of the men at the meeting are jailhouse hard. What does 'jailhouse hard' mean?
options: rough looking and menacing
shaven and well groomed
old and unhealthy
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Jailhouse hard' = مظهر خشن ومهدد كالمجرمين. يوصف الشخص الذي يبدو قاسياً وخطيراً. الخيارات الأخرى: حسن الهندام، قديم.

questions.question: The organization is dedicated to the contentious premise. What does 'contentious' mean?
options: true
debatable
ridiculous
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Contentious' = مثير للجدل. 'contentious premise' = فرضية مثيرة للجدل. الخيارات الأخرى: صحيحة، سخيفة.

questions.question: The evenings' wrenching hour of confession. What does 'wrenching' mean?
options: unfair
final
difficult
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Wrenching' = مؤلم وصعب. 'wrenching hour' = ساعة مؤلمة. الخيارات الأخرى: غير عادلة، نهائية.

questions.question: The group's modest coffers. What does 'modest' mean?
options: fairly small
substantial
empty
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Modest' = متواضع، صغير نسبياً. 'modest coffers' = خزينة متواضعة. الخيارات الأخرى: كبيرة، فارغة.

questions.question: He jabs a meaty finger. What does 'meaty' mean?
options: tiny
dirty
large
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Meaty' = سمين، كبير. 'meaty finger' = إصبع سمين. الخيارات الأخرى: صغير، وسخ.

questions.question: His fingers (with tension) exploring the brim. Replace 'with tension'.
options: nervously
personally
quickly
warily
questions.explanation: 🔍 'With tension' = nervously = بتوتر. الحال المناسب لوصف التوتر هو 'nervously'. الخيارات الأخرى: شخصياً، بسرعة، بحذر.

questions.question: His trousers (with care) raised. Replace 'with care'.
options: abruptly
carefully
wearily
suspiciously
questions.explanation: 🔍 'With care' = carefully = بعناية. الحال المناسب لوصف العناية هو 'carefully'. الخيارات الأخرى: فجأة، بملل، بارتياب.

questions.question: Would like to see him (in person)? Replace 'in person'.
options: nervously
personally
quickly
warily
questions.explanation: 🔍 'In person' = personally = شخصياً. تعني أن ترى الشخص بنفسك وليس عبر وسيط. الخيارات الأخرى: بتوتر، بسرعة، بحذر.

questions.question: He said (with caution). Replace 'with caution'.
options: nervously
personally
quickly
warily
questions.explanation: 🔍 'With caution' = warily = بحذر. الحال المناسب لوصف الحذر هو 'warily'. الخيارات الأخرى: بتوتر، شخصياً، بسرعة.

questions.question: He looked around him (with doubt and mistrust). Replace 'with doubt and mistrust'.
options: abruptly
carefully
wearily
suspiciously
questions.explanation: 🔍 'With doubt and mistrust' = suspiciously = بريبة. 'suspiciously' تعني بشك وريبة. الخيارات الأخرى: فجأة، بعناية، بملل.

questions.question: He stood up (in a sudden, rough manner). Replace the expression.
options: abruptly
carefully
wearily
suspiciously
questions.explanation: 🔍 'In a sudden, rough manner' = abruptly = فجأة. 'abruptly' تعني بشكل مفاجئ وخشن. الخيارات الأخرى: بعناية، بملل، بريبة.

questions.question: He ran out (with a fast movement). Replace 'with a fast movement'.
options: nervously
personally
quickly
warily
questions.explanation: 🔍 'With a fast movement' = quickly = بسرعة. 'quickly' تعني بسرعة. الخيارات الأخرى: بتوتر، شخصياً، بحذر.

questions.question: Lieutenant Anderson shrugged (in a tired way). Replace 'in a tired way'.
options: abruptly
carefully
wearily
suspiciously
questions.explanation: 🔍 'In a tired way' = wearily = بملل. 'wearily' تعني بتعب وملل. الخيارات الأخرى: فجأة، بعناية، بريبة.

questions.question: He developed a ______ when he was nervous.
options: lieutenant
tic
taxpayer
accessory
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Tic' = تشنج عصبي. 'tic' هي حركة لا إرادية تحدث عند التوتر. الخيارات الأخرى: ملازم، دافع ضرائب، مشارك في جريمة.

questions.question: He surrounded himself with a group of ______.
options: tics
accessories
taxpayers
underlings
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Underlings' = تابعون، أشخاص ضئيلو الشأن. 'underlings' هم الأشخاص الأقل مرتبة. الخيارات الأخرى: تشنجات، مشاركون، دافعو ضرائب.

questions.question: They said the sculpture was a waste of ______ money.
options: tics'
accessories'
taxpayers'
underlings'
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Taxpayers' money' = أموال دافعي الضرائب. 'taxpayers'' هي صيغة الملكية الجمع. الخيارات الأخرى: تشنجات، مشاركون، تابعون.

questions.question: He has been promoted to the rank of a ______.
options: lieutenant
tic
taxpayer
accessory
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Lieutenant' = رتبة ملازم. هي رتبة عسكرية. الخيارات الأخرى: تشنج عصبي، دافع ضرائب، مشارك في جريمة.

questions.question: His colleagues find his ______ difficult to deal with.
options: accessory
stubbornness
deliberate
taxpayer
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Stubbornness' = عناد. 'stubbornness' هي صفة العناد والصلابة. الخيارات الأخرى: مشارك، متعمد، دافع ضرائب.

questions.question: The jury took five days to ______ on the case.
options: accessory
stubbornness
deliberate
taxpayer
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Deliberate' = يتشاور، يفكر. 'deliberate on the case' = يتشاور في القضية. الخيارات الأخرى: مشارك، عناد، دافع ضرائب.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: I wish I can swim.
I wish I could swim.
I wish I will swim.
I wish I swim.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'I wish I could swim' = أتمنى لو أستطيع السباحة (رغبة في الحاضر). 'can' و'will' و'swim' غير صحيحة مع 'wish'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: If I was you, I would accept the offer.
If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If I am you, I will accept the offer.
If I had been you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'If I were you' = الشرطية الثانية مع 'were' للافتراض. 'were' تستخدم مع 'I' في الحالات غير الحقيقية. 'was' و'am' و'had been' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: He suggested to go to the cinema.
He suggested going to the cinema.
He suggested go to the cinema.
He suggested that going to the cinema.
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'suggest' نستخدم V-ing أو 'that + clause'. 'suggest going' = اقترح الذهاب. 'to go' و'go' و'that going' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: I am looking forward to see you.
I am looking forward to seeing you.
I look forward to see you.
I am looking forward for seeing you.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Looking forward to + V-ing' = حرف الجر 'to' يتبعه V-ing. 'to see' و'for seeing' و'look forward' (بدون 'am') غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: She is used to get up early.
She is used to getting up early.
She used to getting up early.
She is used for getting up early.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Be used to + V-ing' = معتاد على. 'She is used to getting up early' = معتادة على الاستيقاظ باكراً. 'get up' و'used to getting' (بدون 'is') و'used for' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: I would rather to stay home.
I would rather stay home.
I would rather staying home.
I would rather stayed home.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Would rather + V1' = يفضل. 'I would rather stay home' = أفضل البقاء في المنزل. 'to stay' و'staying' و'stayed' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: I have lived here since 5 years.
I have lived here for 5 years.
I have lived here from 5 years.
I have lived here during 5 years.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'For + فترة' و 'Since + نقطة بداية'. 'for 5 years' = لمدة 5 سنوات. 'since' تتبعها نقطة زمنية، و'from' و'during' غير صحيحة مع المدة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: The police is investigating the crime.
The police are investigating the crime.
The police was investigating the crime.
The police has investigating the crime.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Police' تعامل معاملة الجمع. 'The police are investigating' = الشرطة تحقق. 'is' و'was' و'has investigating' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: The news are good.
The news is good.
The news were good.
The news have been good.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'News' مفرد رغم وجود 's'. 'The news is good' = الأخبار جيدة. 'are' و'were' و'have been' (جمع) غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Hardly I had arrived when it started to rain.
Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain.
Hardly I arrived when it started to rain.
Hardly had I arrived than it started to rain.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Hardly had I... when' = inversion مع الماضي التام. 'Hardly had I arrived when' = بالكاد كنت قد وصلت عندما. 'than' خطأ (تستخدم مع 'no sooner').

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: She told me to wait.
She said me to wait.
She told that I should wait.
She said that I should wait.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Told me to wait' = الصيغة الصحيحة مع 'tell'. 'tell' تأتي مع مفعول به مباشر (شخص). 'say' لا تأتي مع مفعول به مباشر.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: I don't know what is his name.
I don't know what his name is.
I don't know what his name.
I don't know what is name.
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر: فاعل + فعل. 'what his name is' = ما اسمه. 'what is' خطأ في غير المباشر.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Neither the manager nor the employees is happy.
Neither the manager nor the employees are happy.
Neither the manager nor the employees was happy.
Neither the manager nor the employees be happy.
questions.explanation: 🔍 في 'neither...nor' يتفق الفعل مع أقرب فاعل. 'employees' جمع، لذا 'are happy'. 'is' و'was' و'be' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: The number of students are increasing.
The number of students is increasing.
A number of students is increasing.
A number of students are increasing.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'The number...' مفرد، 'A number...' جمع. 'The number of students is increasing' = عدد الطلاب يتزايد. 'A number of students are' = عدد من الطلاب.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence.
options: The car is repaired by the mechanic.
The car was repaired by the mechanic.
The car is repairing by the mechanic.
The car has been repaired by the mechanic.
questions.explanation: 🔍 Present simple passive: is + V3. 'The car is repaired by the mechanic' = يتم إصلاح السيارة بواسطة الميكانيكي. 'was' للماضي، و'repairing' خطأ.
